name: John C. Stennis
summary: John Cornelius Stennis (August 3, 1901 – April 23, 1995) was an American politician who served as a U.S. senator from the state of Mississippi. He was a Democrat who served in the Senate for over 41 years, becoming its most senior member for his last eight years. He retired from the Senate in 1989, and was the last Democrat elected to the U.S. Senate from Mississippi until Scott Colom was elected in 2026.
